page_title: Social Media Scheduler & Publishing Platform for Humans & AI

sources.entry: BulkPublish - Schedule and publish posts to 15 social platforms from one dashboard, API or hosted MCP server for AI agents. #freemium #mcp

summary.name: BulkPublish
summary.one_liner: BulkPublish is a social media scheduler and publishing platform that posts to up to 15 networks from one dashboard, with a REST API and hosted MCP server for AI assistants.
keywords: post to all social media at once
use_cases: schedule a month of posts across several networks
bulk-import a content calendar from a spreadsheet
let an AI assistant draft and schedule posts
turn an RSS feed into social media posts
reply to comments and messages from one inbox
summary.what_it_does: BulkPublish lets you write one post and adapt it per network, with its own caption, media, hashtags and link, then publish now or schedule it on a visual calendar. It supports bulk creation from a CSV, recurring posts, an RSS-to-post feed, and a queue that fills the next open slot. Teams can group accounts, use labels, and send drafts for approval, while clients can connect accounts or review posts through links. Paid tiers add a shared Inbox for comment replies and direct messages, plus analytics with period comparison and an hour-by-hour engagement heatmap. A REST API, Zapier/Make/n8n/IFTTT connectors, and a hosted MCP server let AI assistants create and publish posts.
notable: Hosted MCP server and REST API with Node and Python SDKs, available on every plan including Free
Per-network previews and per-platform captions from one draft, with thread planning for X, Threads, Bluesky and Mastodon
Client connect links and review links so clients can connect accounts or approve posts without shared passwords
Built-in X usage allowance; X posts beyond the allowance use pay-as-you-go credits
caveats: Free plan is limited to 3 accounts (one per platform), 3 scheduled posts, 30 posts a month and no repeat posts, comment replies or social inbox
Comment replies, the social inbox, client links and approvals require Pro or Business
Extra channel slots cost $2.99/month each; X posts are charged separately beyond the included allowance
